# @tfxjs/cache

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

<div align="center"> 	<h1>@tfxjs/cache</h1> 	<p>Lightweight, extensible, fully typed in‑memory cache for TypeScript / Node.js.<br/> TTL · size limit · pluggable strategies (LRU / custom) · fetch missing values · typed event hooks.</p> </div>
